bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || { echo NONEMPTY_WORKTREE; exit 76; }; case "$(git branch --show-current)" in main|master) ;; *) echo EXISTING_BRANCH_OWNED_BY_ANOTHER_CHANGE; exit 80;; esac; command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE; exit 81; }; C=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null) || { echo DOCKER_STATE_UNREADABLE; exit 82; }; if printf '%s\n' "$C" | grep -Eiq 'create.?videobot|videobot'; then echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_ALREADY_RUNNING; exit 83; fi; echo EXISTING_CHECKOUT_CAN_BE_REPOINTED_WITHOUT_RUNNING_VIDEO_CONTAINER
